prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1296; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling in the left-turn lane at an intersection in Pearland, Texas, when the collision occurred. Driver 1 stated that the vehicle was struck on the driver's side while turning left by a vehicle proceeding through the intersection. Driver 2 confirmed this account and did not dispute the sequence of events. Two independent witnesses at the scene described the collision in the same manner, and photographs taken at the location show the points of contact consistent with a side impact of this type. The damage observed on Driver 1's vehicle, including deformation to the driver's door and quarter panel, corresponds closely with the impact described. Driver 1 reported a concussion and was transported for evaluation; the nature of the injury is consistent with the force of the collision. Passenger was also present in the vehicle, and officers and witnesses confirmed that Passenger was seated in the front passenger position at the time of impact. Officers found no indication of prior damage to the vehicle in the areas affected. Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the applicable policy.
